info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Banking Accounts Statements-v2-spec
info.description: The Banking Account Statements Retrieval API enables users to access detailed statements for their banking accounts, providing insights into transactions and account activity. This API allows for the retrieval of statements, ensuring consumers such as banking apps or financial management tools can aggregate and present relevant financial information to their users. Typical use cases include generating reports for personal finance tracking or consolidating transaction data for budget planning. By leveraging this API, developers can enhance their applications' ability to offer users a comprehensive view of their financial histories.

get.description: Fetches a list of statements associated with a specified account, providing detailed information about transactions and balances over a given time period.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve account statements. It should contain all necessary parameters to specify the desired statements, including any filtering or pagination details required to accurately return the statements for the account in question.
